answer:
The current repo rate set by the RBI is 5.25% [3][6]. According to one source, these rates are applicable from 5 December 2025 [3]. Another source also lists the repo rate at 5.25% in its current policy rates table [6].

Note that one article reports a hike to 5.50% in a recent move, but the two sources giving current RBI policy rates list the repo rate at 5.25% [3][6].
